---
name: OpenRGD RFC
title: "[RFC] "
about: Propose a normative standard, contract, governance or ownership change
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Summary

State the proposed decision in one paragraph.

## Problem

Describe the concrete problem and why existing accepted behavior is insufficient.

## Evidence

List code, specifications, physical observations, tests, external standards or historical records. Distinguish direct evidence from inference.

## Proposed normative change

Identify exact files, schemas, ownership boundaries or conformance requirements that would change.

## Alternatives considered

Include preserving the current state.

## Compatibility and migration

Describe wire/schema compatibility, toolchain impact, external repository impact and migration strategy.

## Safety and failure mode

Explain how the proposal fails closed, whether it can affect physical execution and which authority gates remain in force.

## Versioning

Identify the affected version axis and expected SemVer impact.

## Validation plan

Specify producer/consumer tests, fixtures and implementation evidence required before acceptance.

## Open questions

List unresolved questions explicitly. An unresolved question must not be silently treated as decided by implementation.

## Decision record

To be completed after review:

```text
status: PROPOSED | ACCEPTED | REJECTED | SUPERSEDED
accepted_by:
decision_date:
decision_ref:
```
